2.1.1.sql:
SELECT o.order_number, o.opened_at, o.status, s.full_name,
       t.table_number, c.name AS category, mi.name AS item,
       oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_total
FROM orders AS o
JOIN staff AS s ON s.id = o.staff_id
JOIN dining_tables AS t ON t.id = o.table_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN menu_items AS mi ON mi.id = oi.menu_item_id
JOIN menu_categories AS c ON c.id = mi.category_id
WHERE o.opened_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+03'
  AND o.opened_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+03'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
ORDER BY o.opened_at, o.order_number, c.name, mi.name

2.1.2.sql:
SELECT c.name AS category, mi.name AS item, mi.price, mi.is_available,
       COALESCE(oi.quantity, 0) AS ordered_portions
FROM menu_items AS mi
JOIN menu_categories AS c ON c.id = mi.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.menu_item_id = mi.id
WHERE oi.id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.name, mi.name

2.1.3.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.order_number, o.opened_at, s.full_name,
       t.table_number, t.seats
FROM orders AS o
JOIN dining_tables AS t ON t.id = o.table_id
JOIN staff AS s ON s.id = o.staff_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN menu_items AS mi ON mi.id = oi.menu_item_id
JOIN menu_categories AS c ON c.id = mi.category_id
JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'closed' AND t.seats >= 4
  AND c.name = 'Основные блюда' AND p.method = 'card'
ORDER BY o.opened_at, o.order_number

2.2.1.sql:
SELECT s.full_name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders_count,
       COUNT(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'open') AS open_count,
       COUNT(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'closed') AS closed_count,
       COUNT(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_count
FROM staff AS s
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.staff_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
ORDER BY orders_count DESC, s.full_name

2.2.2.sql:
SELECT s.full_name, COUNT(o.id) AS closed_count,
       SUM(COALESCE(t.total, 0)) AS closed_sales,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(t.total, 0)), 2) AS average_check,
       MIN(COALESCE(t.total, 0)) AS min_check,
       MAX(COALESCE(t.total, 0)) AS max_check
FROM staff AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.staff_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS t ON t.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'closed'
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(t.total, 0)) >= 10000.00
ORDER BY closed_sales DESC, s.full_name

2.2.3.sql:
SELECT periods.month, c.name AS category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS portions,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)
           FILTER (WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS sales
FROM menu_categories AS c
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE
        AS month
    FROM orders
) AS periods
LEFT JOIN menu_items AS mi ON mi.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.menu_item_id = mi.id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'closed'
    AND (o.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE >= periods.month
    AND (o.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE
        < (periods.month + INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE
GROUP BY periods.month, c.id, c.name
ORDER BY periods.month, c.name

3.1.sql:
SELECT c.name AS category, mi.name AS item, mi.price,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(peer.price) FROM menu_items AS peer
              WHERE peer.category_id = mi.category_id), 2) AS category_average
FROM menu_items AS mi
JOIN menu_categories AS c ON c.id = mi.category_id
WHERE mi.price > (SELECT AVG(peer.price) FROM menu_items AS peer
                 WHERE peer.category_id = mi.category_id)
ORDER BY c.name, mi.price DESC, mi.name

3.2.sql:
SELECT s.full_name, s.email
FROM staff AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.staff_id = s.id AND o.status = 'closed' AND p.method = 'cash'
)
ORDER BY s.full_name

3.3.sql:
SELECT o.order_number, s.full_name, t.total AS unpaid_amount
FROM orders AS o
JOIN staff AS s ON s.id = o.staff_id
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS t ON t.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'closed'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments AS p WHERE p.order_id = o.id)
ORDER BY o.opened_at, o.order_number

3.4.sql:
SELECT s.full_name,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(t.total, 0)), 2)
        FROM orders AS o
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total
            FROM order_items
            GROUP BY order_id
        ) AS t ON t.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.staff_id = s.id AND o.status = 'closed') AS average_closed_check,
       (SELECT MAX(o.opened_at) FROM orders AS o
        WHERE o.staff_id = s.id) AS last_order_at
FROM staff AS s
ORDER BY s.full_name

4.sql:
WITH

item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
payment_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_total
    FROM payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),


order_metrics AS (
    SELECT o.id, o.staff_id, o.status,
           date_trunc('month', o.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE
               AS month,
           COALESCE(i.order_total, 0) AS order_total,
           COALESCE(p.paid_total, 0) AS paid_total,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(i.order_total, 0) - COALESCE(p.paid_total, 0), 0)
               AS outstanding
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN payment_totals AS p ON p.order_id = o.id
),

monthly_summary AS (
    SELECT month, staff_id, COUNT(*) AS orders_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS closed_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS open_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(order_total) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed'), 0)
               AS closed_sales,
           COALESCE(SUM(paid_total) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed'), 0)
               AS collected,
           COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed'), 0)
               AS closed_debt,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed' AND outstanding > 0)
               AS unpaid_closed_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open'), 0)
               AS open_balance
    FROM order_metrics
    GROUP BY month, staff_id
),

months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT month FROM order_metrics
)
SELECT m.month, s.full_name,
       COALESCE(ms.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count,
       COALESCE(ms.closed_count, 0) AS closed_count,
       COALESCE(ms.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
       COALESCE(ms.cancelled_count, 0) AS cancelled_count,
       COALESCE(ms.closed_sales, 0) AS closed_sales,
       COALESCE(ms.collected, 0) AS collected,
       COALESCE(ms.closed_debt, 0) AS closed_debt,
       COALESCE(ms.unpaid_closed_count, 0) AS unpaid_closed_count,
       COALESCE(ms.open_balance, 0) AS open_balance,
       ROUND(100.0 * ms.collected / NULLIF(ms.closed_sales, 0), 2)
           AS collection_percent
FROM months AS m
CROSS JOIN staff AS s
LEFT JOIN monthly_summary AS ms ON ms.month = m.month AND ms.staff_id = s.id
ORDER BY m.month, s.full_name
